decision.rationale: file-boundary state reuse preserved coverage-output equivalence across four cumulative phases, but it still reloads state between public invocations and therefore leaves the persistent GPU-resident state ABI gap open

next_probe_contract.name: persistent_resident_state_abi_probe
required_behaviors: initialize device resident state once from the CPU-generated 1x1 init-state
advance multiple resident phases without reloading the previous phase GPU dump through a file boundary
compare each cumulative phase against a CPU cumulative repeat reference
capture setup, kernel, teardown, and compare timing separately
keep host-only Verilator internals out of the correctness word set
next_probe_contract.planned_public_workflow: define a public dry-run first, then measure only after the ABI contract is documented and covered by a contract test

non_claims: not persistent GPU-resident state implemented yet
not paged attention or KV-cache scale-up
